appearance_facts.location: A single blue line spans the plot from the left edge near x=270 to the right edge near x=2100, rising overall from y~1180 to y~420.
appearance_facts.fact: The line starts flat, climbs steadily through the middle years, dips briefly around 1888, then climbs sharply to the right edge.

appearance_facts.location: Left segment from 1880 to 1881 (x~270 to x~390).
appearance_facts.fact: The line is nearly horizontal at a low level, around the 1,000-1,100 gridline region.

appearance_facts.location: Middle segment from 1882 to 1885 (x~510 to x~1110).
appearance_facts.fact: The line rises continuously from about the 1,300 level to just under the 2,000 gridline.
The line reaches a local peak near 2,500 at 1887, then drops to a local trough near 2,300 at 1888.

appearance_facts.location: Right segment from 1889 to 1891 (x~1710 to x~2100).
appearance_facts.fact: The line climbs steeply, passing the 2,500 gridline at 1889, the 3,000 gridline at 1890, and ending above 3,000 near 3,200 at 1891.
